description: Test the functionality of accessing documentation resources from the footer and ensure the documentation page loads properly.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Scroll down to the footer section.
Redirect to the documentation page at https://docs.roost.ai.
Verify the presence of API and setup guides.
Confirm the content is readable and accessible.
expected_results: User is successfully redirected to https://docs.roost.ai.
Documentation content is available and readable.
API and setup guides are present on the page.
edge_cases: Documentation link is broken or leads to a 404 error.
Network issues prevent the documentation page from loading.
The 'Documentation' link is missing or disabled.
Content on the documentation page is incomplete or inaccessible.
Page takes too long to load.
data_requirements: Valid documentation link configured in the footer.
User has permissions to view documentation resources.
Session cookies for maintaining navigation state.
dependencies: User has access to the internet.
performance_metrics: Measure the page load time for the documentation page.
Ensure the documentation page is responsive.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Documentation' link has an accessible name or ARIA label.
Validate that keyboard navigation allows interaction with the 'Documentation' link.
Confirm that documentation content is screen-reader compatible.
